summary: Chief Logan has no camping page any more (the old camping page, /?p=11364, now 404s); the park and lodging pages give only the season wording ('spring through summer, weather permitting'), written as the entry's own season note. Fees ($39.99) and the derived hookups/site counts left as recorded; booking stays inherited (no park statement read).
flags: Season wording differs from the agency default: Chief Logan's page says 'open spring through summer', not 'spring through fall'. The booking site still sold Chief Logan electric sites for 2027-04-20 and 2027-06-15 nights (2026-10-12 read); when it closes in late summer/fall is not published.

The derived water/sewer, 26 sites and 40-ft max (from the note) could not be confirmed: wvstateparks.com's Chief Logan camping page is gone (search engines still index it as '26 units, 14 full hookups, 12 electric and water'), and the lodging page gives only the campground's coordinates.
